granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: I don't like dotted line for the website
granted.change: Swapped every dashed outline on the site and the result card for solid lines.
granted.change_zh: 把网站和成绩卡片上的虚线边框全部换成了实线。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: move the bottom right social button to the top aside with language toggle
granted.change: Moved the X and Discord buttons out of the phone footer and into the header, next to the language toggle.
granted.change_zh: 把手机版页脚里的 X 和 Discord 按钮移到了顶部，放在语言切换旁边。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: social media button should adapt dark mode
granted.change: The X and Discord buttons and the Follow Sharky card now follow the dark theme instead of staying white.
granted.change_zh: X 和 Discord 按钮以及“关注 Sharky”卡片现在会跟随深色主题，不再保持白色。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: Make all color and vertical align, change the logo with a cute shark
granted.change: The header logo is now Sharky, and the social, language and theme controls share one colour scheme and one height.
granted.change_zh: 顶部 logo 换成了 Sharky，社交、语言和主题按钮统一了配色和高度。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: It cannot scroll to the bottom
granted.change: Added scroll room on the exam page inside in-app browsers so the last option clears the bottom bar.
granted.change_zh: 在应用内置浏览器里给答题页加了滚动空间，最后一个选项不再被底栏挡住。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: Change the GitHub link to sharkyloop
granted.change: The GitHub and Research links now point to the sharkyloop organisation's repo.
granted.change_zh: GitHub 和研究链接现在指向 sharkyloop 组织的仓库。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: Check every design and make it good
granted.change: Design pass: the wish button no longer sits on the report, header buttons are full-size tap targets on phones, and the report's “vs.” heading is now “Comparison”.
granted.change_zh: 整体检查了一遍设计：许愿按钮不再压住报告内容，手机上顶部按钮恢复到易点的大小。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.change: The score on the report is now an evenly inset tile, with the same padding as the share card under it.
granted.change_zh: 报告里的分数改成了四边留白一致的卡片，和下面的分享卡片对齐。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: The social media cover is not that good
granted.change: Redrew all 44 share covers: Sharky as the logo, solid outlines, an evenly padded score tile, and nothing important under X's title label.
granted.change_zh: 重画了全部 44 张分享封面：Sharky 作 logo，实线边框，分数卡片留白一致，重要内容避开 X 的标题标签。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: Change the top left logo more align to frontier human topic
granted.change: New pixel logo: Sharky the agent with a question mark over its head, wondering what the human meant.
granted.change_zh: 新的像素 logo：头顶问号的 Sharky，正在琢磨人类到底是什么意思。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.change: Eight of the twenty questions moved out of the codebase into everyday life: a birthday dinner, a failed flight booking, a wedding invitation, Grandma's birthday. Same replies, same traps.
granted.change_zh: 二十道题里有八道从代码搬进了日常：生日晚餐、没订上的机票、婚礼请柬、奶奶的生日。回复和陷阱都没变。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: Make the human answers more natural
granted.change: A few replies now read the way people type them: “2nd one”, “yep”, “yeah that one”. The bare “or” replies stay, since they are the whole point.
granted.change_zh: 几句英文回复改得更像随手打的字：“2nd one”“yep”“yeah that one”。只回一个“or”的那几题没动，那正是考点。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.change: Scores like 20/20 on the report no longer run into their bars.
granted.change_zh: 报告里像 20/20 这样的分数不再压到进度条上。

granted.author: edward40e
granted.wish: Make the social media more interesting
granted.change: Shared results now come with a confession or a dare that depends on your score, and each cover carries a one-line quip.
granted.change_zh: 分享成绩时会按分数配一句自嘲或挑战，每张封面也多了一句俏皮话。
